data.spiritual_significance: In the context of Islamic spirituality, Mehran can be understood as a reminder of Allah's mercy and kindness towards His creation. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) once said, "Allah is kind and loves kindness" (Bukhari and Muslim). By giving a child the name Mehran, parents are invoking the blessings of Allah, asking Him to shower His mercy and kindness upon their child, and helping them grow into compassionate and kind individuals. Additionally, the name Mehran can serve as a daily reminder for the bearer to show kindness and mercy towards others, emulating the character of Allah.
